header.headline: Stefan Gjurcheski
header.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer | .NET / C# | Angular / React
header.intro:
Senior Full-Stack Software Developer with 5+ years of experience building and maintaining end-to-end web applications across financial, government, and enterprise environments. Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, EF Core, T-SQL, Angular, React, TypeScript and REST APIs.

Experienced in working on production systems, complex business workflows, document-management platforms and e-banking applications. Comfortable joining existing development teams, taking ownership of features, fixing issues, improving existing codebases and delivering new functionality independently.

**Available for remote freelance/contract work — up to 20 hours/week.**

projects.projectDescription: E-Banking Platform — Production financial platform used across multiple European countries.

- Develop and maintain full-stack functionality for an e-banking platform.
- Work across backend and frontend components using C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, EF Core, T-SQL and React.
- Work with authentication and identity infrastructure using IdentityServer.
- Contribute to development workflows using Azure DevOps.
- Work on secure, business-critical financial software within a regulated environment.

Worked on multiple enterprise and government document-management systems:
- eCabinet North Macedonia — internal document-management and decision-making platform.
- eParliament — document-management system.
- Official Gazette North Macedonia — platform for publishing classifieds by notaries and executors.
- Developed and maintained backend functionality using C#, .NET Core, .NET Framework, EF Core and T-SQL.
- Developed frontend functionality using Angular and Angular.js.
- Worked with Material UI.
- Delivered functionality across multiple enterprise applications with complex business workflows.
Worked on the New Intertec Website.

- Developed a web application for buying, sending and staking fungible tokens on the XinFin Blockchain Network.
- Maintained a desktop application for remote monitoring of miners.
- Worked on web applications and REST APIs using Java/Spring Boot and React.
- Developed REST API functionality for a mobile application for Anhoch.com.
